content.text: Read Cargo.toml with the read tool and tell me the workspace member crates in one short sentence.

1	[workspace]
     2	resolver = "2"
     3	members = ["crates/pi-star-core", "crates/pi-star-server"]
     4	default-members = ["crates/pi-star-server"]
     5	
     6	[workspace.package]
     7	version = "0.1.0"
     8	edition = "2024"
     9	license = "MIT"
    10	rust-version = "1.85"
    11

    18	futures-util = "0.3"

    29	serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
    30	serde_json = { version = "1", features = ["preserve_order"] }
    31	sha2 = "0.10"
    32	thiserror = "2"
    33	tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }

The workspace has two member crates: `crates/pi-star-core` and `crates/pi-star-server` (with the server as the default member).
